newsitem.title: UK: UK's Computacenter sees '97 revs near 1.0 bln stg.
newsitem.headline: UK's Computacenter sees '97 revs near 1.0 bln stg.

text.p: British independent Computacenter said on Monday it expected its turnover to reach nearly 1.0 billion stg in 1997, boosted by service revenue growth.
The distributor of information technology systems and services posted pretax profits of 39.9 million stg in 1996 compared with 14.7 million stg a year earlier.
Turnover jumped to 804.5 million stg from 503.1 million stg in 1995.
The company said service revenues contributed more than 100 million stg to its total turnover.
"Service revenues will continue to make up a significant proportion of the company's turnover," the firm said in a statement. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
